badge.name: Web Foundations
badge.description: Recognizes the named activity after instructor review at the confirmed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M6A3 (Publish Your Portfolio).

Award threshold: 75%.

m6a3: Publish Your Portfolio. Published a personal HTML and CSS portfolio on GitHub Pages. The assessment covered a working public URL, a home page and loading assets, meaningful content, intentional styling and a site finished enough to share.
